materials.name: Full-grain Vegetable-Tanned Cowhide
materials.note: Vegetable tanning — the method of using plant tannins to turn hides into leather — is at least 7000 years old. The process yields a flexible and incredibly tough leather that feels smooth against the skin and has a rich, earthy aroma. All our pieces are made from full-grain leather, the highest grade available.

materials.name: Italian Suede
materials.note: Chosen for its remarkable combination of softness, toughness, and breathability — goatskin suede feels luxuriously plush against the skin, for hours of comfortable wear.

materials.name: Neoprene Padding
materials.note: Sandwiched between the outer leather and inner suede lining, closed-cell neoprene adds a springy cushion that conforms to the wearer when cinched down tight, and won't compress over time.

materials.name: Fully Hand Stitched
materials.note: Hand stitched using traditional methods and braided polyester thread, for a beautiful and unreasonably strong bond that machines can't replicate.

materials.name: Solid Brass Hardware
materials.note: Gorgeous brass hardware with a heft you can feel and the strength to match. Nickel-plated or left bare depending on collection.

materials.name: Responsibly Sourced
materials.note: All leather is sourced from adult animals raised for their meat and milk. We vow never to use calf or lamb skin in any of our products, as these animals are often raised specifically for their hides.

products.name: Wrist Cuffs
products.description: These padded leather bondage cuffs are designed for comfort and built for durability, with soft suede, neoprene padding, and heavy-duty brass hardware for serious play.
